name: qa
description: Manual QA runs driven through a browser — derive the scenarios from the ticket and the diff or execute the list you were handed, write them down as a scenario file under docs/qa/<TASK>/ with preconditions and dependencies, execute them with Playwright in a QA window that stays open between runs (Chromium or Brave, own profile) or through the user's own Chrome, assert against values fixed before the run, caption every screenshot with what it proves, and report pass/fail/blocked with reproduction steps
